title: Extract shopping list header content
description: Add a pure helper that identifies and returns the free-text header markdown that appears above checklist-backed aisle sections.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.extract(from:)` returns `HeaderContent?` with markdown and first heading metadata.
Extraction skips the H1 title, stops at the first checklist line or checklist-bearing `##` section, and includes prose-only `##` sections such as Meals or Notes.
The helper tolerates empty content and Windows line endings.
